title: Complaints to Traffic Police about Noisy Vehicles in Last Three Years
what_it_is: Complaints to Traffic Police about Noisy Vehicles in Last Three Years

sections.label: Speeding noise feedback Nee Soon South
sections.summary: From 2017 to 2019 TP received 147 noise feedback items, 11 on Nee Soon South, and stepped up enforcement with three speed cameras.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: From 2017 to 2019, the Traffic Police (TP) received 147 pieces of feedback on noise generated by speeding vehicles.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Of these, 11 pertained to Nee Soon South.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In response to feedback on speeding in Nee Soon South, including along Yishun Avenue 1 and Yishun Street 51, TP have stepped up its enforcement operations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Also, there are now three speed cameras in the area.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The latest was installed in March 2019 towards Yishun Avenue 8.

sections.label: Vehicle noise emission regulations
sections.summary: Motor vehicles must meet noise emission limits under Environmental Protection and Management regulations, and in-use vehicles failing inspection standards cannot renew road tax.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Noise pollution from roads could be due to a number of factors, including speeding and illegal modification of vehicle exhaust systems, which can generate excessive noise.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, motor vehicles that ply Singapore's roads are required to comply with the noise emission limits stipulated under the Environmental Protection and Management regulations.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: In-use vehicles are also required to comply with the stipulated in-use noise emission standards during the mandatory periodic inspection and vehicles that do not meet the in-use noise standards will not have their road tax renewed and cannot be used on the roads.

sections.label: TP refers modified exhausts to LTA
sections.summary: TP looks out for speeding offences and refers vehicles with possibly illegally modified exhaust systems to LTA for checks.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: TP will look out for speeding offences and when they come into contact with vehicles that may have their exhaust systems 	illegally modified which lead to excessive noise, they refer these to LTA which then conducts the checks as to whether or not there was illegal modification done.
